verdict.rationale: Granola's first-party docs describe in-product AI insights at several levels. Granola Chat answers questions and gives 'instant insights' across all meetings, a single meeting, or a folder, and can 'spot patterns across customer calls'. Recipes save insight prompts for one-click reuse, and AI-enhanced notes link each point back to its source in the transcript. The product also makes proactive suggestions: overnight pre-meeting briefs with open threads and agenda points, and auto-drafted follow-up emails. A community user calls it 'highly capable at summarisation', but another reports that its action items tended to slip through. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of Chat and pattern-spotting insight quality, and evidence that action-item suggestions are reliable.
